name: Minimal
summary: Big stacked caps in a warm cream serif over your torso, tiny one-word captions at the left edge, a hand-drawn word now and then. Nothing bounces.
notes: Titles show in CAPS, one short line per slash: "LEAVE IT / FOR 24 / HOURS". They sit over the torso. Type them in caps too, so each line is sized for its capitals.
The hook is a title with a "sub" line: it moves to the top by itself, and the sub becomes the small spaced-out handwritten line under it.
Mark 1 word now and then with "accent": true: it turns into the hand-drawn emphasis word.
Screenshots and charts: popup with "frame": true gets a white rounded border. The red X sticker is themes/minimal/red-x.svg (use its full path as the sticker's src).
End line: a cta with a short line and an emoji, in white.
css: .cap { left: 64px; right: auto; max-width: 420px; text-align: left; text-transform: lowercase; font-family: @accent !important; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

.title .tsub { font-family: @accent !important; font-size: 30px !important; letter-spacing: .34em !important; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF !important; padding-top: 22px !important; line-height: 1.2; }
.cta { background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; color: #FFFFFF !important; text-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }
